name: Content
tagline: Portfolio and blog publishing on a calendar, drafts until you approve
description: Made for the portfolio-and-blog side of a design practice. It sets the content strategy and keeps a calendar, drafts every post for review, and amplifies only once you have said go. Nothing publishes itself, which keeps the feed in your voice even while the cadence runs on automation.
author: stevenvillarino
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
